title: Funding Deposit Amount — Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service Treasury Worksheet
content:
The funding deposit on a Paystride Instant Pay Disbursement Service is the amount by which the funding level exceeds the prefund balance the ledger shows, that is every deposit, returned payout, recall and fee credit less every returned deposit, payout, fee and withdrawal on the service, the funding level being the alert level on file; a deposit that is due is at least the tier's smallest prefund deposit and is rounded half up to the cent, and when the balance already meets the funding level no deposit is due.

The funding level is the alert level on file plus every amount that applies, then raised once by the sum of every percentage that applies, the percentages being added together into one rate rather than applied one after another; the balance is subtracted after that, and the result is rounded once, at the end.

The alert level on file is the low-balance alert recorded on the service, and the smallest prefund deposit is the tariff figure of the tier held.

## Worksheet (hypothetical: alert level on file 2400.00, smallest prefund deposit 150.00)

| Ledger balance | Funding level exceeds the balance by | Funding deposit |
|---|---|---|
| 1975.50 | 424.50 | 424.50 |
| 2330.00 | 70.00 | 150.00 (raised to the smallest deposit) |
| 2400.00 | nothing — the balance meets the funding level | none due |
| 2600.00 | nothing | none due |

## Assembly figures (hypothetical)

- An amount of 300.00 added to the alert level of 2400.00 gives 2700.00; one rate of 8 percent raises it to 2916.00; less a balance of 1975.50 the deposit is 940.50.
- An amount of 17.777 added to 2400.00 gives 2417.777; one rate of 10 percent raises it to 2659.5547; less a balance of 1000.00 the result is 1659.5547, rounded once at the end to 1659.55.
